purpose: Supabase product surface: Auth, CLI, client libraries, Edge Functions, Realtime, Storage, and Supabase debugging.
use_when: Working with Supabase Auth (login, JWT, cookies, RLS surprises from auth claims)
Using Supabase CLI, MCP server, client libraries, Edge Functions, Realtime, or Storage
Debugging Supabase project errors: permission denied, schema cache, timeouts, logs
do_not_use_when: Plain Postgres SQL rules, schema authoring, or RLS policy writing -> supabase-postgres-best-practices
GPU, CUDA, or ML model work
scope: Only touch files the task names; everything else read-only.
disambiguator: Supabase product surface (Auth, CLI, JS libs) -> this. Postgres rules and SQL/RLS authoring -> supabase-postgres-best-practices.
